headline: UK Budget funds a unit to respond to rogue AI agents
body: The UK Budget confirmed its AI security package, including £120 million more for the AI Security Institute and £40 million for a unit to detect and respond to rogue agentic systems. New York banned AI companions from posing as humans to minors (Tech Backlash +0.14), Anthropic told California's governor courts should be able to block risky models, and India is weighing a separate safety regime for the most powerful models. Together they lifted Alignment & Control by 0.24. The Information reported OpenAI plans to buy Google's TPU chips (Capability Velocity +0.11). Protector God, Gatekeeper and Enslaved God rose. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -17.19 from -17.43.
movers_note: Protector God +0.2, from Anthropic's letter to Newsom (+0.07), the OpenAI TPU report (+0.06), New York's law (+0.05) and the UK Budget (+0.04), partly offset by fading news (-0.04). Gatekeeper +0.2, from the letter (+0.06), the TPU report (+0.05) and New York's law (+0.04). Enslaved God +0.2, from the TPU report (+0.07) and the letter (+0.05).
coming_up: New York's AI companion law takes effect on 1 January 2027
